job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy NLP models using Python and Generative AI techniques to solve complex business problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and implement solutions that meet customer needs.
Develop data pipelines to extract insights from large datasets and integrate them into existing systems.
Troubleshoot issues related to model performance, data quality, and system integration.

Job Requirements :

6-12 years of experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP) or a related field.
Strong proficiency in Python programming language with expertise in machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn or TensorFlow.
Experience working with Generative AI models like GANs or Transformers is highly desirable.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics or a related field.
